name: managed-remote-access-failure-categories
description: Stable deny/failure category taxonomy and audit category taxonomy for the managed remote-access lane (merge unit A, TASK-5771). Every deny outcome and every audit row maps to one of these fixed categories. Categories are tenant-neutral by construction: they never name, hint at, or distinguish the existence of a specific tenant, cell, home, or device (no cross-tenant existence oracle). Audit categories are lowercase snake_case stable identifiers; failure details are redacted category-level prose that never contains raw exception text or credential material.

deny_categories.description: The authenticated identity (account, device, connector, node) is missing, unknown, wrong-audience, or not establishable. Never confirms whether the referenced identity exists.
Enrollment or redemption attempt failed: wrong cell, wrong home, wrong device, consumed, or unknown enrollment. Never confirms whether the target exists.
Tenant cell isolation violation: cross-cell reference, forged cell identity, or cell policy forbids the relationship. Denies without confirming other-cell existence.
Policy/revocation state is absent, empty, malformed, stale, future, rolled back, or failed to compile/apply. Connector fails closed; never falls back to allow-all.
Peer map absent, incomplete, or withheld: the node receives no map/peer entries it is not entitled to.
Peer not present or not authorized in the current cell map; no cross-cell peer data is ever provided.
Pairing authorization missing, revoked, expired, or bound to a different device/home. Denied with the same category whether the home exists or not.
Request device is not the currently paired/current device for this home; stale device identity rejected.
Device, home, or credential is revoked. New requests denied and live streams closed before or atomically with node removal; never success early.
Proof or credential is replayed, reused, or presented out of order. Single-use and nonce/timestamp rules rejected.
Credential or proof is expired or outside its validity window.
Normalized method+path is not on the explicit remote allow-list (forbidden class or unclassified). Default deny.
HTTP method is unsupported for the surface or forbidden for the method (e.g. mutating method on a read-only surface).

Method/path failed normalization: encoded traversal, ambiguous percent encoding, dot-segment escape, duplicate-slash ambiguity, control bytes, or absolute-form/authority ambiguity. Ambiguity is denied.
Relay (DERP) path denied: relay cannot create reachability the cell policy denies; relay admission rejected.
Direct WireGuard path denied or unavailable for this relationship.
Transport-level denial: non-connector-port, client-to-client, home-to-client, or other topology/transport attempt denied.
Local daemon boundary failure: daemon unavailable, not loopback-bound, bearer unreadable, or bearer-shaped material detected in remote input. Fails closed.
Internal/unknown failure inside the connector or control plane. Redacted to category; no raw exception text crosses any boundary.
Unclassifiable outcome. Redacted to category; treated as deny for authorization purposes.

audit_categories.description: Positive control: an allowed, fully validated request was forwarded to the loopback daemon.
Identity could not be established; no existence confirmation.
Enrollment/redemption denied; no existence confirmation.
Tenant/home/device/cell binding check denied.
Pairing authorization denied (missing, revoked, or wrong device/home).
Current-device identity mismatch denied.
Revoked identity denied before the request was authorized.
Live HTTP/SSE/WebSocket stream closed because of revocation.
Replayed or out-of-order proof denied.
Expired credential or proof denied.
Single-use credential consumed or reused denied.
Credential audience mismatch denied.
Credential bound to a different home denied; no existence confirmation.
No policy/revocation state present; failed closed.
Policy artifact malformed or signature invalid; failed closed.
Policy/revocation epoch behind required; failed closed.
Policy/revocation epoch ahead of accepted window; failed closed.
Policy/revocation epoch decreased; failed closed.
Policy compiler failed; no traffic authorized.
Policy apply failed; no traffic authorized.
Peer map absent or withheld.
Peer absent or unauthorized.
Topology violation denied (client-to-client, home-to-client, non-connector-port).
Normalized route not allowed (forbidden class).
Method not allowed for the surface.
Route not classified in the allow-list; default deny.
Path/method failed normalization; ambiguity denied.
Direct path denied for the relationship.
DERP relay denied; relay creates no reachability beyond cell policy.
Attempted DERP bypass of cell policy denied.
Non-connector-port attempt denied.
Route/subnet advertisement forgery quarantined and denied.
Exit-node advertisement/use denied.
SSH advertisement/use denied.
Forged tag assertion denied.
Bearer-shaped material in remote input rejected; local daemon boundary protected.
Local daemon unavailable or not loopback-reachable; connector failed closed.
Daemon bind mismatch detected; connector failed closed.
Internal failure; redacted to category.
Unclassifiable failure; treated as deny.

existence_guard.rule: Audit categories are a fixed enumerated set, and paired cases (target exists vs target absent) MUST produce identical deny and audit categories. A denied request never distinguishes 'tenant/cell/home exists but denies you' from 'does not exist'. No cross-tenant existence oracle is permitted in audit fields, failure details, error responses, or logs.
